title: Fix 3 bugs in python_blog_app routes
description: Brownfield Python dirty scenario: index, api_posts, and api_create_post each have a bug. Fix them so all 6 tests pass.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix the 3 bugs in src/app.py so all 6 tests pass.

  def index():
    — passes all posts to template instead of only published ones
    — fix: published = [p for p in _posts if p["published"]]

  def api_posts():
    — returns all posts including unpublished
    — fix: return jsonify([p for p in _posts if p["published"]])

  def api_create_post():
    — returns HTTP 200 instead of 201
    — fix: change 200 to 201

Do not modify the test file.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: index filters to published posts only
api_posts filters to published posts only
success_criteria: uv run python -c "from src.app import app" passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.build: uv run python -c "from src.app import app"
